item.title: Arteta expects Guimarães to ‘ignite’ Arsenal and help take team to new level
item.summary: Arsenal lose 3-2 to Borussia Dortmund in Emirates Cup Man City’s wide players shine in 3-2 win against Atlético The Arsenal manager, Mikel Arteta, has backed “warrior” Bruno Guimarães to “ignite something different” in the Premier League champions. The Brazil midfielder was introduced to fans ahead of Sunday’s 3-2 defeat by Borussia Dortmund in the Emirates Cup after completing his £75m move from Newcastle. The 28-year-old, who has signed a four-year deal , bolsters a midfield which already includes Declan Rice, Martin Ødegaard, Mikel Merino, Martín Zubimendi and Eberechi Eze. Continue reading...
